title: Multi-Agent Dynamics, Collective Intelligence, and Systemic Risk
subtitle: Expanded multi-agent interaction requires a population contract binding agent/owner/model/organization identities, human participants, interaction… resources, commitments, decision assumptions, entry/exit/copying/learning, population outcomes, externalities, human influence, interventions, costs, and residuals.

display.problem: Individually valid agents and pairwise exchanges can compose into miscoordination… collusion, coalitions, cascades, concentration, common-mode failure, and gradual human disempowerment.
display.insufficient: Pairwise protocol validity, aggregate reward, apparent cooperation, equilibrium, nominal agent… establish collective intelligence, non-collusion, systemic safety, or retained human agency.
